name: news
instructions:
A sentence was said near a person. Decide what it does.

news: it tells that something is new, different, cancelled, moved, required, forbidden, ready, waiting or about to happen; or it asks someone something, asks them to do something, or warns them.
noNews: it says that things are as they were, that nothing has changed, that something is not happening after all, or it takes back a rumour ("still at nine", "same place as before", "no, it is not closing").

A "no longer", "not allowed" or "cancelled" that changes what people must do is news.
